title: Cat Walk
bpm_method: Initial librosa beat_track sequence least-squares fit 129.996656 BPM; direct multiband attack fit validates nominal 130.000 BPM and measured 0.0023s source phase. No time stretch.

initial_librosa_fit.note: tracker selected offbeat; final attack phase corrected from measured multiband novelty

hit_classification_note: Candidate timbral labels from frequency bands, not isolated instrument ground truth. Snare requires body150-500Hz and face1-3kHz attack within15ms. Kick40-160Hz may also contain syncopated bass. HPSS inspection used to diagnose offbeat tracker.

method.envelope: 5ms centered RMS; positive difference over5ms; global unconstrained peak detection min65ms apart, prominence1% band maximum; negative roundoff floored before sqrt
method.coverage: union of independently detected four-band attacks; evaluated nearest attack within30ms
method.fit_scope: selected80-beat source span only; no full-song grid claim

winning_grid_reason: 130 BPM agrees with fitted tracker period and preserves the quarter-note musical pulse;65 is metrical half-time undersampling with the same sparse-grid coverage,260 tests eighth-note subdivisions. Tempo is not chosen by maximizing density.
